heroDescription: A showcase of generations of craftsmanship, custom masonry, high-end remodeling, and custom home construction across central Florida.

items.title: Modern Farmhouse Estate
items.description: Proud custom construction of a modern farmhouse featuring generations-strength timber frame beams, state-of-the-art kitchen, wrap-around brick porch, and luxury master suite.

walkthroughSlides.label: EXTERIOR FACADE
walkthroughSlides.title: Generations-Strength Timber Frame Structural Detail
walkthroughSlides.desc: Precision joinery showcase using native Florida timber-framing architecture designed to endure.

walkthroughSlides.label: Wooden Design
walkthroughSlides.title: Wooden Paneling Design
walkthroughSlides.desc: Custom-crafted solid oak island, commercial gas range, and premium quartzite surfaces.

walkthroughSlides.label: GREAT ROOM
walkthroughSlides.title: Open-Concept Great Room & Vaulted Beams
walkthroughSlides.desc: Expansive ceiling heights supported by exposed mortise-and-tenon interlocking timber trusses.

walkthroughSlides.label: COVERED PORCH
walkthroughSlides.title: Generational Outdoor Living & Brick Porch
walkthroughSlides.desc: Seamless indoor-outdoor entertainment space with hand-laid brick columns and cypress ceiling.

walkthroughSlides.label: MASTER SUITE
walkthroughSlides.title: Master Suite Retreat & Custom Architecture
walkthroughSlides.desc: Tranquil master sanctuary featuring custom architectural millwork and panoramic pasture views.

walkthroughSlides.label: CRAFTED DETAILS
walkthroughSlides.title: Hand-Forged Hardware & Precision Finish
walkthroughSlides.desc: Every joint, latch, and beam corner meticulously finished by master tradespeople.

items.challenge: Our clients envisioned a timeless estate that looked as if it had sat on their Williston acreage for a hundred years, yet possessed the energy-efficiency and luxurious open layouts of modern builds. Structurally, the great room required massive, raw structural timber spans without visible heavy steel connectors, demanding old-world precision joinery.
items.solution: Ferrentino & Son engineered a pure timber frame architecture, leveraging authentic Florida pine beams and custom mortise-and-tenon interlocking joints. Our custom design team wrapped the home in high-performance insulation, framing gorgeous viewports facing the pasture. The state-of-the-art kitchen integrates commercial-grade power behind solid oak cabinetry, balancing new homestead charm with refined culinary luxury.
items.quoteText: The level of detail Ferrentino & Son brought to our timber frame joints is absolutely stellar. It is a genuine masterpiece that our grandchildren will enjoy.

items.title: Ocala Oak-Wood Remodel
items.description: A complete whole-home remodel highlighting custom cabinetry, vaulted ceilings, and meticulous hardwood finishings tailored exactly to client entertaining styles.

walkthroughSlides.label: LIVING AREA
walkthroughSlides.title: Vaulted Great Room Remodel
walkthroughSlides.desc: Reopened sightlines and raised ceilings bring light and scale to the main living area.

walkthroughSlides.label: CUSTOM CABINETRY
walkthroughSlides.title: Whole-Home Cabinetry Package
walkthroughSlides.desc: Matching hardwood cabinetry ties the kitchen, bar, and built-ins together.

walkthroughSlides.label: FINISHING DETAIL
walkthroughSlides.title: Hardwood Finish Work
walkthroughSlides.desc: Hand-finished trim and flooring selected to match the home's original character.

items.challenge: The existing floor plan felt closed-off and dated, with low ceilings and disconnected living spaces that didn't suit the family's entertaining style.
items.solution: We opened the main living areas, raised ceiling heights where structurally possible, and built a matching suite of custom hardwood cabinetry throughout the home to unify every room.
items.quoteText: Ferrentino & Son turned our cramped, dated house into a home that finally works the way we live.

items.title: The Marion County Chef's Kitchen
items.description: High-end remodel featuring commercial-grade range setups, warm solid oak structural posts, custom quartz waterfalls, and a custom build layout designed to last generations.

walkthroughSlides.label: CHEF'S RANGE
walkthroughSlides.title: Commercial-Grade Range Wall
walkthroughSlides.desc: Professional venting and power routed behind a custom tile backsplash.

walkthroughSlides.label: ISLAND
walkthroughSlides.title: Quartz Waterfall Island
walkthroughSlides.desc: A oversized island anchors the kitchen with seating for six.

walkthroughSlides.label: STRUCTURAL POSTS
walkthroughSlides.title: Exposed Oak Structural Posts
walkthroughSlides.desc: Structural posts were kept exposed and finished as a design feature.

items.challenge: The client, an avid home chef, needed commercial-grade cooking capability in a kitchen that still felt warm and residential.
items.solution: We built out dedicated commercial-grade range and ventilation infrastructure, wrapped in warm solid oak posts and a quartz waterfall island that keeps the space feeling like home.
items.quoteText: It's a professional kitchen that still feels like the heart of our home.

items.title: Lake Weir Spa Sanctuary
items.description: Bespoke master bath remodel emphasizing zero-threshold rain shower systems, natural stone masonry work, custom lighting, and dedicated floor-heating integrations.

walkthroughSlides.label: RAIN SHOWER
walkthroughSlides.title: Zero-Threshold Rain Shower
walkthroughSlides.desc: A curbless entry and natural stone masonry create a true spa experience.

walkthroughSlides.label: SOAKING TUB
walkthroughSlides.title: Freestanding Soaking Tub
walkthroughSlides.desc: Positioned beneath a picture window with custom ambient lighting.

walkthroughSlides.label: FINISHES
walkthroughSlides.title: Heated Stone Flooring
walkthroughSlides.desc: Radiant floor heating installed beneath natural stone tile.

items.challenge: The original bathroom was cramped, poorly lit, and lacked any of the spa-like comfort the clients wanted for their lakeside retirement home.
items.solution: We reconfigured the layout around a curbless rain shower and freestanding tub, adding natural stone masonry, layered lighting, and radiant floor heating.
items.quoteText: Every morning feels like a trip to the spa now.

items.title: Silver Springs Equestrian Pavilion
items.description: Commercial grade timber and masonry structure crafted for equestrian events and outdoor hosting with custom architectural beamwork.

walkthroughSlides.label: PAVILION FRAME
walkthroughSlides.title: Commercial Timber Beamwork
walkthroughSlides.desc: Heavy timber trusses span the full event pavilion without interior columns.

walkthroughSlides.label: OUTDOOR EVENT SPACE
walkthroughSlides.title: Outdoor Hosting Pavilion
walkthroughSlides.desc: Covered masonry patio designed for equestrian events and gatherings.

walkthroughSlides.label: SITE DETAIL
walkthroughSlides.title: Site Masonry & Grading
walkthroughSlides.desc: Custom grading and masonry work integrate the pavilion with the surrounding pastures.

items.challenge: The client needed a column-free covered space large enough to host equestrian events, without compromising the sightlines to the surrounding pastures.
items.solution: We engineered long-span heavy timber trusses that eliminate interior columns entirely, paired with durable masonry flooring built for year-round event use.
items.quoteText: We can finally host every event under one roof, rain or shine.

items.title: Historic Downtown Ocala Loft
items.description: Comprehensive restoration of a historic commercial building transformed into modern executive suites and lounge spaces.

walkthroughSlides.label: EXECUTIVE SUITES
walkthroughSlides.title: Modern Executive Suites
walkthroughSlides.desc: Historic brick shell restored around new executive office suites.

walkthroughSlides.label: LOUNGE
walkthroughSlides.title: Restored Lounge Space
walkthroughSlides.desc: Original architectural details preserved alongside modern finishes.

walkthroughSlides.label: FACADE
walkthroughSlides.title: Historic Facade Restoration
walkthroughSlides.desc: Original facade masonry restored to meet downtown historic guidelines.

items.challenge: The century-old building needed a full structural and systems overhaul while preserving its historic street-facing character under downtown preservation guidelines.
items.solution: Our team restored the original masonry facade, reinforced the structure, and rebuilt the interior into modern executive suites and lounge space while keeping key historic details intact.
items.quoteText: They respected the building's history while making it work for a modern business.
